title: One SEO panel on every page type
problem: SEO settings were only on some pages, and categories and landing pages had none.
now: Pages, posts, products, categories and landing pages share one panel with all nine SEO controls.
steps: Under Search engine listing press Edit.
Write a description, then open Social share and Structured data.
notes: Where: Online Store › Pages / Blog posts / Products › a product / Categories / Landing pages › SEO

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
